description: Authoritative registry of recognized AGCP constraint types used during Proposal Qualification, Governance Decision Function processing, Governance Self-Protection, Execution Authorization, Commit Boundary processing, and related conformance assessment.

registry_rules.stability: Constraint type identifiers are stable registry keys and SHALL NOT be repurposed.
registry_rules.extensibility: Implementations MAY define extension constraint types in an implementation or profile-specific namespace, provided extension constraints do not weaken AGCP normative behavior.
registry_rules.unknown_constraint_type_behavior: Unknown constraint types SHALL fail closed unless explicitly permitted by an applicable governed exception or extension profile.
registry_rules.determinism: Constraint evaluation SHALL be deterministic for identical authoritative inputs.
registry_rules.evidence: Constraint evaluation outcomes SHALL be reflected in Governance Evidence where the evaluation is governance-significant and attributable to a governed object.

fields.default_stage: Primary AGCP stage in which the constraint is normally evaluated.
fields.applies_to: Objects or contexts to which the constraint type applies.
fields.required_inputs: Authoritative inputs normally required to evaluate the constraint.
fields.failure_behavior: Required behavior when the constraint fails.
fields.governance_evidence: Whether Governance Evidence is normally required.
fields.description: Normative description of the constraint type.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Structural Refusal
constraint_types.description: Verifies that a Proposal contains the mandatory structure, identifiers, governed object references, Action Representation, and Governance Context required for Proposal Qualification.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Structural Refusal or artifact rejection
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the submitted object conforms to the applicable schema without requiring implementation-specific interpretation.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Structural Refusal or artifact rejection
constraint_types.description: Verifies that required provenance, signatures, attribution, and binding information are present, valid, and logically associated with the submitted governed object.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Refusal, denial, or forbidden access
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the request, resource, authority, evidence, and governance artifact remain within the authorized tenant scope.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Refusal, denial, or governed re-evaluation
constraint_types.description: Verifies that governance-domain boundaries, domain sovereignty, and governed cross-domain authority relationships are preserved.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Refusal or authorization failure
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the tenant state permits the requested governance operation.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Governed Re-evaluation Required or refusal
constraint_types.description: Verifies that authoritative Canonical State required for governance evaluation is available.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Governed Re-evaluation Required, refusal, or authorization failure
constraint_types.description: Verifies Canonical State completeness, consistency, integrity, provenance, freshness, and suitability for the governed evaluation.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Governed Re-evaluation Required or denial
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the complete applicable governance policy set has been resolved before governance decision processing proceeds.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Artifact rejection or activation denial
constraint_types.description: Verifies that a Policy Evaluation Module is valid, deterministic, integrity-protected, and suitable for governed operational use.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Refusal, denial, authorization failure, or activation denial
constraint_types.description: Verifies that authority is established, attributable, valid, unexpired, unreplayed, and sufficient for the requested governed operation.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Refusal, denial, authorization failure, or governed re-evaluation
constraint_types.description: Verifies delegated authority scope, constraints, lifetime, revocation status, and replay protection.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Pending Human Review, Deferred, or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Determines whether human review is required and whether submitted human-review artifacts satisfy the applicable governed requirement.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Pending Human Review or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the required human-review roles, approvals, or cosignatures satisfy the applicable governed quorum requirement.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Ignore exception or fail affected constraint
constraint_types.description: Verifies that a governed exception is tenant-scoped, authority-backed, unexpired, applicable, and recorded in the decision basis.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Commit Boundary failure or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the qualified Action Representation has not been mutated after qualification.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Commit Boundary failure, authorization failure, or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that the Governance Context remains authoritative, valid, and suitable for continued governance processing.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Authorization Failure or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that all prerequisites for producing or retaining Execution Authorization remain satisfied.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Commit Boundary failure or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that all prerequisites required immediately before execution are satisfied.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: DEGRADED, Suspend Execution, Governed Termination, or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies whether governed execution may continue when continuation conditions are evaluated after Commit Boundary processing.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Evidence rejection, replay rejection, or conformance failure
constraint_types.description: Verifies that Governance Evidence contains sufficient information to establish traceability, attribution, processing state, and replayability.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Evidence rejection, replay rejection, or conformance failure
constraint_types.description: Verifies authenticity, integrity, attribution, traceability, chronological ordering, and logical association with the governed object.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Replay rejection or conformance failure
constraint_types.description: Verifies that authoritative evidence and referenced inputs are sufficient to deterministically reconstruct governance processing.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Artifact rejection or activation denial
constraint_types.description: Verifies integrity, provenance, authority, and suitability of governance-significant artifacts before operational use.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Activation denial or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies that governance-significant artifacts become operationally effective only after all applicable validation and activation prerequisites are satisfied.

constraint_types.failure_behavior: Coordination refusal, suspension, or Governed Re-evaluation Required
constraint_types.description: Verifies participant authority, coordination constraints, participant independence, tenant/domain isolation, and prevention of unauthorized authority propagation.
